sources.reference: Hassan doctoral thesis, April 2025; CoFeNiMnV reference system is different from author-confirmed Al–Co–Fe–Ni–Mn

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S01
supplementary_figures.caption: XRD patterns of CoFeNiMnV/NCNTs prepared at 700, 800, 900 and 1000 °C. Reference characterization, not a new measurement of the PDMS composite.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-1a, printed p. 131, PDF p. 142.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S02
supplementary_figures.caption: Raman spectra of the same reference series. The source reports I_D/I_G values of 1.18, 1.05, 0.96 and 0.94 for 700, 800, 900 and 1000 °C, respectively.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-1b, printed p. 131, PDF p. 142.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S03
supplementary_figures.caption: Reference CoFeNiMnV/NCNTs-800 nanocomposite. TEM overview with the original 50 nm scale bar. This is cited precursor characterization.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-3a, printed p. 133, PDF p. 144.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S04
supplementary_figures.caption: Reference CoFeNiMnV/NCNTs-800 nanocomposite. Higher-magnification TEM image with the original 10 nm scale bar. This is cited precursor characterization.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-3b, printed p. 133, PDF p. 144.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S05
supplementary_figures.caption: Reference CoFeNiMnV/NCNTs-800 nanocomposite. HRTEM image with source annotations of approximately 0.35 nm carbon-layer spacing and 0.22 nm alloy-lattice spacing. The original 5 nm inset scale bar is retained. This is cited precursor characterization.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-3c, printed p. 133, PDF p. 144.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S06
supplementary_figures.caption: Reference CoFeNiMnV/NCNTs-800 nanocomposite. HAADF-STEM and elemental maps of Co, Fe, Ni, Mn, V and C. The original 50 nm HAADF scale bar is retained; no new scale is assigned to the individual maps. This is cited precursor characterization.
supplementary_figures.source: Hassan thesis, Figure 6-3d, printed p. 133, PDF p. 144.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S16
supplementary_figures.caption: Compressive stress-strain curves of PDMS and functionalized foams. The source labels 5% and 20% HEA@CNTs loading, defined by the author as the mass percentage of HEA@CNTs in HEA@CNTs plus unmodified CNTs.
supplementary_figures.source: Original Supporting Information, S1 panel a.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S17
supplementary_figures.caption: Cyclic compressive stress-strain response including the trace labelled Cycle 1000. The abscissa must be confirmed from the original dataset.
supplementary_figures.source: Original Supporting Information, S1 panel b.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S18
supplementary_figures.caption: Seebeck coefficients at foam thicknesses of 3, 4, 5 and 6 mm. Error bars are retained as supplied; their definition and number of replicates need confirmation.

supplementary_figures.name: Figure_S19
supplementary_figures.caption: Resistance response under a periodic pressure of 200 Pa. This demonstrates detection at 200 Pa and does not establish a statistical detection limit.
supplementary_figures.source: Original Supporting Information, S3 panel a.

supplementary_figures.caption: Transient loading and unloading response with source-labelled response and recovery times of approximately 200 and 110 ms. The response-time convention needs confirmation.
